Package neqsim.thermo.util.steam

Class BrineSalinityCorrection

java.lang.Object
neqsim.thermo.util.steam.BrineSalinityCorrection
public final class BrineSalinityCorrection extends Object
Salinity corrections for the density and viscosity of an aqueous phase, after Batzle and Wang (1992).

The correlations of Batzle, M. and Wang, Z., "Seismic properties of pore fluids", Geophysics 57(11), 1396-1408 (1992), Eqs. 27a, 27b and 32, treat the salt as NaCl. They are applied here as ratios brine/fresh water evaluated with the same correlation, so that the correction can be multiplied onto any fresh-water value (an equation of state or a reference equation) without inheriting the absolute error of the correlation. The published range is up to 350 C, 100 MPa and a NaCl mass fraction of about 0.32.

1.0

    • viscosityRatio

      public static double viscosityRatio(double temperature, double salinity)
      Calculates the ratio of brine viscosity to fresh-water viscosity. The correlation has no pressure dependence and is held at its 0 C value below the freezing point of fresh water.

      salinity - salt mass fraction [kg/kg solution]
      Returns:
      viscosity ratio [-]
